question: Do TACSTD2 (TROP2) and CLDN4 track the ICI-favorable SCLC-I (inflamed) subtype?

impower133_patient_level.reason: EGA EGAS00001004888; no public leftover contains TACSTD2 or CLDN4

george_2015_bulk_n81.interpretation: Neither gene is an SCLC-I marker. TACSTD2 is non-NE/epithelial. CLDN4 is epithelial/SCLC-A and anti-CD8.

chan_2021_atlas.interpretation: TROP2 is almost off on SCLC tumor cells. Nominal immune association is FDR-NS and collapses after dropping 2 stroma-dominant donors. CLDN4 is epithelial/SCLC-A, immune-null.

bottom_line: IMpower133 cannot answer this publicly. Public leftovers say TROP2/CLDN4 do not mark SCLC-I.
